Command replay (a class of call, not one reported incident)

Stop an agent trying to reset your database

What happens

Prisma migrate reset with force. The call below tries to reset your database. The agent sends it through its Bash tool, and it involves Prisma.

The call

npx prisma migrate reset --force

Tool: Bash. The replay uses placeholder tokens and hosts only.

Fix it without us

Keep the production DATABASE_URL out of the agent environment, and give the agent a throwaway database for resets. Apply changes to production with prisma migrate deploy, which runs saved migrations and never resets.

What KYA does

Replay result: Held. In the replay test, the local hook asks the person before the call runs. On a host without an ask contract the same rule denies.

Rule prisma-migrate-reset, first stopped in version 0.35.0.

The hook is local and advisory. It fails open: if kya breaks or times out, the call goes ahead.

Install

For Claude Code, the host this replay ran on:

/plugin marketplace add The-Pixel-Boys/shield-kya
/plugin install kya@shield-kya

For any host:

npm i -g @shield-agent/kya@latest && kya start
